invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Iterator as per the method body, either a new JavaLazyInsertIterable or Collections.singletonList(...).iterator().
When recordItr has items, result is a JavaLazyInsertIterable which will haveNext. Otherwise, it's a singleton iterator that also hasNext for the empty list.
idPfx is supplied as a String parameter (used as argument), and usage in new JavaLazyInsertIterable presumes it is not null.
